contentsScope: All regular tracked files from the exact tagged source commit, including unchanged frontend, backend, tests, examples, release notes, bilingual handoff and city-history guides, and existing third-party notices. Root MANIFEST.json is the historical frontend handoff manifest.
excluded: Git metadata, runtime state, credentials/environment files, .DS_Store, untracked artifacts, and release output files.
publication: No publication, push, deployment, or license change.
